description: Use this when the user asks for an image ad, ad creative, product photo or social post graphic for their business or product, or an ANIMATED GIF (format gif) or SVG file (format svg). It renders a finished image on a real image model, on their saved brand (product photos, logo), and returns a URL ready to post. For a video, use render_ad. The saved brand’s product photo is used automatically (see get_brand / list_product_photos), so never ask the user to upload it again. refImages (paths or URLs) composite a real product into the scene. MULTI-BRAND: hydration uses the SAVED brand; for a different brand (a fresh draft_brand) pass its own productImages/logo as refImages with useBrand:false, or the wrong product lands in the shot. Product photos also pick the ENGINE (the compositing model), so a named `model` is honoured only when no references ride; raw:true or useBrand:false keeps it. model = a catalog id from hermoso_capabilities (omit for the default). A PRODUCT IN A PERSON’S HANDS, or a garment on them: name an id marked `needsRefs` with a `refsMax`; person photo first, then up to three product/garment photos. It EDITS THE PHOTOGRAPH: the person is RE-POSED (stance and hands change; face, clothing, setting and light are kept), so it is the wrong tool when the rest must stay untouched. GIF / SVG run on gpt-image-2.6 / 2.6-flare from the prompt alone (no refImages); frames + frameMs shape a GIF. RAW MODEL ACCESS: raw:true dispatches your prompt to the model BYTE-IDENTICAL — no rewriting, no appended guidance, no negative prompt, no brand references attached on your behalf. Credits, the durable delivery of the finished asset and the per-model validation are unchanged. Seconds. Spends credits.

aspectRatio.description: e.g. '1:1', '9:16', '16:9', '4:5'. Each model draws its own list (hermoso_capabilities prints it per model, e.g. Nano Banana 2 goes to 1:8 and 8:1); a ratio the chosen model cannot draw is refused before anything is charged

complexity.description: gpt-image-2.6 / 2.6-flare only: how much the model plans before drawing (default high, best for dense text and complex layouts; low suits a small focused change). No separate charge

fixLabel.description: default true: when the saved brand's product photo rides in this render, the product's label on the finished image is READ and compared with the photo, and re-printed from the photo at close range ONLY if it came out wrong (a label that is already right costs only the check; a re-print costs more, and dryRun:true returns the up-to price). The reply says whether the label was checked, fixed or left as rendered (`labelPass`). Pass false when the user wants the packaging left exactly as generated: nothing is checked or re-printed.

format.description: the file to make (default png). gif = an ANIMATED GIF, a short loop with no sound (describe the subject, the motion and the loop); svg = an editable VECTOR (logo, icon, flat illustration). Both run on gpt-image-2.6 (default) or gpt-image-2.6-flare and take no refImages, mask or markup; the saved brand's photos stay off them. hermoso_capabilities prints each one's credits under `formats`

frameMs.description: format gif only: milliseconds per frame, 20 to 2000, rounded to 10 (default 200; 9 frames x 200 = a 1.8 s loop)

frames.description: format gif only: frames in the loop, 2 to 16 (default 9)

imageSize.description: pixel-size preset for models that support it: 1K/2K, and 4K on the models hermoso_capabilities lists with a 4K imageSize price (a 4K ask on any other model is refused, free) — omit for the default

job.description: what the picture is for. With no `model` named it renders on the engine judged best for that job (hermoso_capabilities `jobEngines.image` lists them): static_ad (the default when neither `model` nor `job` is given) = a finished image ad with its headline, copy and button on the picture; product_photo = a studio, lifestyle, flat-lay or spotlight photo of the real product; marketplace = a listing card; thumbnail = a video cover (make_thumbnail is the full thumbnail pipeline); character_sheet = a multi-view sheet of one person; vector = a logo, icon or flat illustration as an editable SVG (it takes no reference pictures, so the saved brand's photos stay off it). A named `model` always wins

logoPlacement.description: overlay: real logo file laid flat. in_scene: the scene leaves a blank patch on the object and the real file is printed onto it (perspective, light). Never drawn by the model. auto (default): from the prompt

mask.description: MASKED EDIT — change ONE region and keep the rest: a mask (path or URL, any size) for refImages[0]. TRANSPARENT = change, or on a mask with no transparency WHITE = change, black = keep; the reply says which it read. The mask guides rather than stencils, so the change can blend a little past its edge. Runs on gpt-image-2.6 (`refs.mask` in hermoso_capabilities): leave `model` empty or name it; another named model is refused, free. Needs refImages; keeps the source image's frame, so aspectRatio is not applied.

model.description: image model id from hermoso_capabilities. A model whose `refs.mode` is "edit" there (gpt-image-2.6, gpt-image-2.5) takes your refImages on ITS OWN editor, up to its `refs.max`, instead of the default compositor

prompt.description: REQUIRED on every model EXCEPT the pose rows below. the full image prompt — subject, composition, lighting, and any on-image ad text. ON A POSE MODEL (product-in-hand / try-on) THIS IS EXTRA DIRECTION AND IT IS OPTIONAL — leave it out and the pose is built for you. If you do write one, DESCRIBE THE POSE ("she holds the bottle upright in her right hand at chest height, label to camera"); do NOT phrase it as a swap ("replace the mug with the bottle"), which is REFUSED for free, because the product then comes out the size of whatever it replaced — a 30ml bottle rendered mug-sized in testing.

raw.description: RAW MODEL ACCESS: run the caller’s prompt on the named model with no Hermoso adjustments at all — the prompt reaches the provider byte-identical (no hex-to-colour-name rewrite, no prepended fidelity preamble) and NO saved-brand product photos are attached, so the model you name is the model that renders. Use it to drive the raw catalog; leave it off for an on-brand ad. Billing, the durable Library landing and per-model validation are unchanged.

refImages.description: local file paths or URLs of product/logo references to composite in. ON THE POSE MODELS — any row hermoso_capabilities marks `needsRefs` with a `refsMax`, such as putting your product in someone’s hands or a virtual try-on — THE ORDER IS THE CONTRACT AND IT IS NOT A COMPOSITE: refImages[0] is the PERSON photo, and the rest (up to `refsMax` minus one) are the product or garment photos. Reversed, you get the product wearing the person. A 4th product is dropped and the reply says so. Using a real person’s face, likeness or voice confirms you are them or have their consent, take full, unlimited responsibility for its use and will cover any claim against Hermoso (hermoso.ai/terms). Paid plan only; recorded.

useBrand.description: default true: with no refImages, the server hydrates the SAVED brand’s product/logo references so the output lands on-brand; pass false for a pure prompt-only render
